description: This file implements constant folding and graph manipulation utilities for PyTorch's FX graph module, including a ConstantFolder class and functions for tagging and extracting constant subgraphs.

classes.name: ConstantFolder
classes.description: A class for performing constant folding on FX graphs, including node replacement and impurity checks.

methods.name: replace_node_with_constant
methods.description: Replaces a node in the FX graph with a constant attribute.

methods.name: ConstantFolder.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the ConstantFolder with a GraphModule and options.

methods.name: ConstantFolder.is_impure
methods.description: Determines if a node is impure and should not be folded.

methods.name: ConstantFolder.node_to_last_non_output_use
methods.description: Finds the last non-output uses of nodes for potential garbage collection.

methods.name: ConstantFolder.run_node
methods.description: Executes a node, possibly replacing it with a constant.

methods.name: ConstantFolder.insertable_tensor_check
methods.description: Checks if a tensor can be inserted as a constant.

methods.name: ConstantFolder.add_node_replacement
methods.description: Records a node replacement with a constant tensor.

methods.name: ConstantFolder.run
methods.description: Runs the constant folding process over the graph.
